title: Mango Lime Coconut Chia Pudding
summary: A bright vegan breakfast inspired by Mexican flavours, with creamy coconut chia pudding, juicy mango and a fresh lime finish. Make it the night before for an easy, refreshing morning meal.
steps: In a bowl or jar, whisk together the coconut milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, 1 tablespoon of lime juice and a pinch of salt until the chia seeds are evenly dispersed.
Let the mixture stand for 5 minutes, then whisk again to break up any clumps. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until thick and spoonable.
Toss the diced mango with the remaining 1 tablespoon lime juice.
Spoon the chia pudding into two bowls or glasses, top with the limey mango and sprinkle with desiccated coconut.
Serve cold, adding an extra splash of coconut milk if you prefer a looser texture.
